Some of the things these so-called wizards do... They border on necromancy. Or worse! It's just not proper magic." —Venerable Sorcerer Fob Dunar

Decrease damage taken by {damage_reduction_pct}. | Unlocked at level 10. | Truly powerful Wizards have been known to turn their magic inward, transmuting the very composition of their own bodies for boundless energy and catlike reflexes.
Reduce all cooldowns by {cooldown_reduction_pct}. | Unlocked at level 13. | So long have you focused on twisting reality to your will that time itself seeks to appease you.

Increase all damage done by {damage_bonus_pct}, but decrease Armor and resistances by {resistance_pct}. | Unlocked at level 16. | "How will I survive? I don't intend to get hit in the first place. If you even touch me, it's because I allowed it." —Maloth, renegade wizard

When you cast a Signature spell, you gain {gain_resource} Arcane Power. | The following skills are Signature spells: | Magic Missile | Shock Pulse | Spectral Blade | Electrocute | Unlocked at level 20. | "Heavy steel armor may turn aside a blade, but let's see how well it works against lightning!" —Larra Stormlash's infamous faux pas at the Royal Westmarch Joust

Increase your maximum Arcane Power by {max_pool_resource} and Arcane Power regeneration by {regen_per_second_resource} per second. | Unlocked at level 24. | "Feel the power in the veil that surrounds us—a thunder cloud ready to burst... a volcano about to erupt. Harness it, and you will be invincible." —Adria

When you take more than {damage_threshold_pct} of your maximum Life in damage within {duration_seconds:window} second, the cooldowns on Mirror Image, Slow Time, and Teleport are reset. | When you use Mirror Image, Slow Time, or Teleport, your movement speed is increased by {movement_speed_pct} for {duration_seconds:speed} seconds. | Unlocked at level 27. | "To be where you are not is the wisest of strategies." —Grand Archmage Ralhys

Enemies chilled or frozen by you take {damage_taken_pct} more damage from all sources for the duration of the chill or Freeze. | Unlocked at level 30. | "Feel your blood run cold as the water of the Frozen Sea, and know that I can shatter you with a touch." —The Ice Queen's Tale

Fire damage dealt to enemies applies a burning effect, increasing their chance to be critically hit by {crit_taken_pct} for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 34. | "The red hot armor seared their flesh and boiled their blood as they tried desperately to pry it from smoldering bodies. We finished the defenseless creatures as an act of mercy." —Tales of Caldeum, Volume XII

Lightning spells have a {proc_chance_pct} chance to Stun all targets hit for {stun_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 37. | "Some people are shocked by my mastery of magic." —Larra Stormlash

As long as you have not taken damage in the last {duration_seconds} seconds you gain a protective shield that absorbs the next {absorb_capacity_life_pct} of your Life in damage. | Unlocked at level 40. | "Power begets power. The excess energy from one spell is absorbed by the other, and so the effect is sustained." —Excerpt from Grand Master Clavaught's Lecture on Synergistic Effects in Esoteric Arcane Spheres

Enemies that take Arcane damage are slowed by {slow_pct} for {slow_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 45. | "The energies of time and arcane power are jealous consorts. If you caress the one, you neglect the other at great risk." —Ennead Sage Resko

Killing an enemy grants a shield that absorbs {absorb_capacity_life_pct} of your Life in damage for {absorb_duration_seconds} seconds. This effect can stack up to {max_stacks_count} times. | Refreshing Dominance will set the shield to its maximum possible potency and each stack will increase its total duration by {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 50. | "Why waste your own energy? Using your enemy's to protect yourself strengthens you while it weakens him. What could be more perfect?" —Ennead Sage Resko

When you cast a Signature spell, you gain a Flash of Insight. After {stack_threshold_count} Flashes of Insight, your next non-Signature spell deals {damage_bonus_pct} additional damage. | The following skills are Signature spells: | Magic Missile | Shock Pulse | Spectral Blade | Electrocute | Unlocked at level 55. | Dare not to invoke the wrath of a Wizard. You are nothing more than a loose coalescence of dust before their ire, easily scattered at a whim.

When you receive fatal damage, you instead gain a shield equal to {absorb_capacity_life_pct} of your maximum Life for {duration_seconds} seconds and release a shockwave that knocks enemies back and Stuns them for {stun_duration_seconds} seconds. | This effect may occur once every {internal_cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 60. | "It takes perfect concentration for a Wizard to dance on the edge of infinity. Never be the one to break that concentration." —One-Eye Whipple

Standing still for {duration_seconds} seconds increases the following attributes: | Armor: {armor_pct} | All Resistances: {resistance_pct} | Damage: {damage_bonus_pct} | Unlocked at level 64. | "At times the greatest strategy is to withdraw into yourself, to experience the clarity of mind in the moments before launching your attack." —Archmage Skye

You deal {damage_bonus_pct} additional damage to enemies within {radius_yards} yards. | Unlocked at level 66. | "Those who dare approach you do so at their own peril." —Valthek, High Councilor of the Vizjerei

Damaging enemies with Arcane, Cold, Fire or Lightning will cause them to take {damage_taken_pct} more damage from your attacks for {duration_seconds} seconds. Each different damage type applies a stack, stacking up to {max_stacks_count} times. | Elemental damage from your weapon contributes to Elemental Exposure. | Unlocked at level 68. | Adding insult to injury may be entertaining, but adding increased injury is a more effective tactic.
